Fields.Name: Material Param Name
Fields.Description: Name of the shader material parameter to override, matched by name (for example "[Albedo]_1_[Tint]"). Up to 31 characters.

Fields.Name: Target Material ID
Fields.Description: Which of the model's materials receive the override. -1: every material on the model. Only used by NpcParam resident overrides; SpEffect overrides always cover every material.

Fields.Name: Material Param Value - R
Fields.Description: First component of the value written to the parameter (R for colours). Only used by NpcParam resident overrides.

Fields.Name: Material Param Value - G
Fields.Description: Second component of the value written to the parameter (G for colours). Only used by NpcParam resident overrides.

Fields.Name: Material Param Value - B
Fields.Description: Third component of the value written to the parameter (B for colours). Only used by NpcParam resident overrides.

Fields.Name: Material Param Value - A
Fields.Description: Fourth component of the value written to the parameter (A for colours). Only used by NpcParam resident overrides.

Fields.Name: Material Param Value - I
Fields.Description: Fifth component of the value written to the parameter (usually intensity). Only used by NpcParam resident overrides.
